identificationModule.briefTitle: S0307 Phase III Trial of Bisphosphonates as Adjuvant Therapy for Primary Breast Cancer.
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase III Trial of Bisphosphonates as Adjuvant Therapy for Primary Breast Cancer

armGroups.label: Arm I
armGroups.description: Patients receive zoledronate IV over 15 minutes once a month for 6 months and then once every 3 months for 2.5 years.

armGroups.label: Arm II
armGroups.description: Patients receive oral clodronate once daily for 35 months.

armGroups.label: Arm III
armGroups.description: Patients receive oral ibandronate once daily for 35 months.
